tracks.title: Programming for fun in the age of AI
tracks.speaker: Stian
talkDescription: Programming stupid things for fun is... well, fun. Now a days we could get agents to do the programming, and we would be left with all the fun.
Would we though? Is the fun in the result or the process? Is programming for shits and giggles even more important now than ever? If so, why?
